nodes.label: FourBranch

semantic.label: FourBranch
semantic.expression:
class FourBranch(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.left = MLP()
        self.right = MLP()
        self.project = nn.Linear(16, 4)
        self.fallback = nn.Identity()
        self.third = MLP()
        self.fourth = MLP()

    def forward(self, x, flag=True):
        a = self.left(x)
        b = self.right(x)
        if flag:
            c = a + b + (self.third(x) + self.fourth(x))
            y = self.project(c)
        else:
            c = self.fallback(a + b)
            y = self.project(c)
        return y
